label: Y2K Bubblegum Gloss
_schema: Every slot below shares the same generic field set: asset, x, y, width, height, z, anchor, opacity, blendMode, interactive, action, hitBounds, recolorGroup. `present:false` slots keep their real field names but omit `asset`/geometry — they render nothing (BubblegumGlossSkin.jsx renders a slot only when manifest marks it present, no CSS fallback ever). `decorations` is an array so multiple real pieces can be placed without ever duplicating one asset to fill space.

shell-accent-mask.reason: depends on shell-base; needed for real recolor of the carcasa

screen-frame.reason: bezel is fused to screen-content and to the mini-transport buttons in the source art — confirmed inseparable via strict alpha-mask segmentation (threshold 192 still one component)

screen-background.reason: screen/background-alt.png exists as a clean stand-in texture but is not decomposed as a true swappable background layer yet

screen-fused-interim.note: INTERIM piece, not one of the canonical screen-* slots above: bezel+content+mini-transport as extracted (fused, can't be decomposed further from this sheet). Used for rendering today until screen-frame/background/glass/highlight exist separately.

mini-prev.reason: baked into screen-fused-interim, physically fused to the screen bezel — not separable

assembled-reference.reason: no full assembled-player reference image supplied yet
assembled-reference.note: When supplied (assembled-reference.png), it becomes the ABSOLUTE authority for composition, proportions, alignment, scale and position — superseding the sheet-native coordinates every other slot uses today.

decorations.note: 6 individual bubbles as extracted (composited once onto one transparent canvas at their real relative positions, not split into separate files) — see README. Placed once; never duplicated to fill space.

screen.note: Interior text-safe area inside screen-fused-interim, excluding the baked mini-transport column.

palette._note: measured directly from the sheet's own RECOLOR MASK / ACCENT swatch legend. Not yet consumed — no shell-accent-mask exists to apply them to.
